أَمْرٌ كَارِثٌ , and ↓ كَرِيثٌ , An affair that presses severely upon one; that oppresses, afflicts, distresses, or vexes. (K.) ―
-b2- كَرَثَتْهُ الكَوَارِثُ Affairs pressed heavily upon him; or oppressed him. (A.) الكُرْبُ الكَوَارِثُ [Oppressive sorrows, or anxieties.] (S.) (See Har. p. 245)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
